newsitem.title: CANADA: WCE canola ends up on commercial demand.
newsitem.headline: WCE canola ends up on commercial demand.

text.p: WCE canola ended up on commercial demand as locals sold longs, traders said.

"There was late local liquidation in the Nov on the soybeans. UGG sold August and bought November, RBC bought August scale down at the close and sold November, Cargill bought November," a trader said. November WCE futures crush margin fell to -7.02 Tuesday from -5.79 Monday. Aug-Nov $6, Aug-Dec $6, Aug-Sep $10.
August rose $3.90 to $347.10, November up $5.50 to $340.60. July flax rose $8.40 to $338.90 as Louis Dreyfus covered shorts on low stocks, November lost $0.20 to $283.80.
UGG bought 25 July peas unchanged at US$170.50, traders said.
July western barley rose $0.90 to $120 on commercials, October lost $0.30 to $122.50 on hedges, Alberta Wheat Pool sold December down $0.20 to $123.60 to locals. Volume 325.
Local short covering of July feed wheat buoyed that contract $0.90 to $144.10 and December fell $0.30 to $148.50. Oct-Dec spread at even money. Volume was 400 lots.
Louis Dreyfus sold 10 December oats to XCan, traders said.
(All values in Canadian dollars except oats, peas.)
